messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: SURPASS-CVOT randomized 13,299 adults with type 2 diabetes and established cardiovascular disease.
The adults were randomized to Mounjaro (tirzepatide, up to 15 mg once weekly) or dulaglutide 1.5 mg once weekly.
Dulaglutide is a GLP-1 medicine already approved to reduce cardiovascular risk.
The study had a median follow-up of about 4 years.
Cardiovascular death, non-fatal heart attack, or non-fatal stroke occurred in 12.1% of those taking Mounjaro.
These events occurred in 13.0% of those taking dulaglutide.
The hazard ratio was 0.92 with a 95% CI of 0.83–1.01.
The results met the trial's goal of non-inferiority.
The results did not demonstrate superiority.
Death from any cause occurred in 8.5% of the Mounjaro group.
Death from any cause occurred in 10.1% of the dulaglutide group.
The hazard ratio was 0.84 with a 95% confidence interval of 0.75–0.94.
This outcome was not a primary endpoint.
This outcome was not adjusted for multiple comparisons.
Therefore, the result should be read as exploratory.
These results describe how Mounjaro performs against another GLP-1.
Triplet: ["dulaglutide", "approved to", "reduce cardiovascular risk"]

The relation 'approved to' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is approved for the therapeutic purpose or indication specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. B. 'has approval status': The subject drug has the regulatory approval status specified by the object entity.
C. 'has benefit': The subject drug has the benefit or therapeutic effect specified by the object entity.
D. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
E. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
